name: Xpress Addons for Elementor
author: pencilwp

sections.description:
Xpress Addons for Elementor adds widgets, templates, and a header and footer builder for Elementor. Build hero sections, services, testimonials, sliders, and more. Every widget is lightweight, responsive, and easy to use.

Features

  • Unique and stylish Elementor addons to enhance your website’s design and functionality.
  • Simple and intuitive customization options to personalize your website according to your preferences.
  • Seamless integration with the Elementor page builder for a smooth user experience.

Widgets in Free Version

  • Header & Footer Builder – Dedicated Header & Footer Builder for Elementor.
  • Hero Area – Create stunning hero sections with headlines and buttons.
  • Service Card – Showcase your services with modern service cards.
  • Testimonial Slider – Display client feedback in a beautiful slider.
  • Portfolio Slider – Highlight portfolio projects in a stylish slider.
  • Tabs Widget – Organize content into elegant responsive tabs.
  • Blog Widgets – Show recent posts or blog grids with custom layouts.
  • Brand, Client or Partners Slider – Showcase logos in a smooth slider.
  • Circle Progress Card – Display progress or stats with animated circles.
  • Call to Action Card – Grab attention with attractive CTA cards.
  • Stylish Image Card – Present images with creative hover effects.
  • Contact Info Card – Share business contact details in a neat card.
  • Image Card – Simple and elegant image display with text support.
  • Progress List – Show milestones or steps with progress indicators.
  • Section Title – Add beautifully designed section headings.
  • Buttons Widget – Create stylish customizable buttons.
  • List Style Types – Display lists with modern icons and styles.
  • Navigation Menu Widget – Add custom navigation menus with styling.
  • Contact Form 7 Integrated – Embed and style Contact Form 7 forms.
  • Mailchimp Form Integrated – Collect subscribers with Mailchimp forms.
  • Elementor Table – Table elements with flexible table widgets.
  • WooCommerce Product List – Display selected products with flexible options.
  • WooCommerce One-Page Checkout – Clean one-page checkout experience.
  • Theme Demos importer – Import starter kits for supported themes.
    • More coming.

Credits

This plugin was created by Pencilwp.

Support

For support and inquiries, please contact support@pencilwp.com.

Resource Credits

All third-party resources and assets used in this plugin are GPL v2 or later, or MIT licensed, ensuring compatibility with open-source software standards.

License

This plugin is released under the GPL v2 or later License. See the LICENSE file for more information.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the x-addons-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Install and activate Elementor if it is not already active.
  4. You will now see new widgets and features added to your Elementor editor.
sections.faq:
How do I use the new addons added by this plugin?

Once the plugin is activated, open the Elementor editor. The widgets are in the Xpress Addons category. Example search: Xpress: Hero Section

Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and active. WordPress will prompt you to install Elementor when you activate this plugin.
sections.changelog:
2.0

  • Public brand updated to Xpress Addons for Elementor. The plugin slug, text domain, widget IDs, and saved pages are unchanged.
  • Aligned plugin version constants and headers for a consistent release.
  • Added Requires Plugins header for Elementor dependency.
  • Restored plugin text domain loading for translations.
  • Replaced remote Google Fonts on Theme Demos admin with system font stacks.
  • Softened Premium upsell copy (removed false urgency messaging).
  • Added LICENSE file and ABSPATH guards across PHP includes.
  • Expanded Theme Demos support and Navigation Menu mobile/drawer controls.
  • Improved admin settings and Header & Footer Builder stability.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
